releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.2.2

- PLAYER TRADING: new Trading tab. Send an axe to another player by username for logs (or as a gift). The axe is held in escrow until they accept, and you can cancel any open offer.
- LEADERBOARD FIXES: saves that had a name but no linked account (or that chose "play offline") are no longer stuck. Added a Connect to Leaderboard button, automatic re-claim of your saved name, and clearer errors/timeouts when loading standings.
